name: 43065 · Powell, OH
findings: ZIP 43065 (Powell) has 162 nonprofit organizations. 68 of them (42%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 58 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (21% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 43065 (Powell) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 43065 (Powell) list civic or political action on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.7 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 7 organizations here; 38% of all organizations here have no identified type.
